name: Semaglutide (Wegovy) for Chronic Weight Management — Molina NJ NJ-RX-SEMA-OB-2024

branches.initial: Initial prior authorization for semaglutide (Wegovy) for chronic weight management

criteria.description: Medical necessity for semaglutide (Wegovy) in chronic weight management: BMI threshold AND age AND failed lifestyle intervention AND chronic-weight-management indication.

policy_citation.quote: Authorization is approved when ALL of the following criteria are met

children.description: BMI ≥ 30 (obesity) OR BMI ≥ 27 with at least one weight-related comorbidity (HTN, dyslipidemia, T2DM, OSA).
Body mass index of 30 kg/m² or greater (obesity).

policy_citation.quote: Body mass index of 30 kg/m2 or greater (obesity)

evaluation.extraction_hints: Find Observation with LOINC 39156-5 (BMI) ≥ 30, or compute from height (LOINC 8302-2) and weight (LOINC 29463-7). ICD-10 Z68.3*/Z68.4* also indicate this range.

verdict_rubric.not_met: Documented BMI < 30 kg/m² (the 27+comorbidity branch may still satisfy this requirement).
verdict_rubric.unclear: Weight and height present without explicit BMI computation; or only narrative reference to 'obesity' without value.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: No BMI, weight, or height measurement available.

children.description: BMI ≥ 27 with at least one weight-related comorbidity (hypertension, dyslipidemia, type 2 diabetes mellitus, obstructive sleep apnea).

policy_citation.quote: Body mass index of 27 kg/m2 or greater with at least one weight-related comorbidity (hypertension, dyslipidemia, type 2 diabetes mellitus, obstructive sleep apnea)

evaluation.extraction_hints: BMI ≥ 27 from Observation AND at least one Condition matching: hypertension (I10-I15), dyslipidemia (E78.*), type 2 diabetes mellitus (E11.*), or obstructive sleep apnea (G47.33).

verdict_rubric.met: BMI ≥ 27 documented AND at least one of the four qualifying comorbidities is on the problem list or visit diagnosis.
verdict_rubric.not_met: BMI ≥ 27 but none of the four comorbidities present; or BMI < 27.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Comorbidity narrative is suggestive but uncoded (e.g., 'pre-diabetes' without E11 confirmation, 'borderline hypertension' without I10).
verdict_rubric.not_documented: Either BMI or comorbidity status is missing from records.

children.description: Patient is 18 years of age or older at the time of the prior-authorization request.

policy_citation.quote: Patient is 18 years of age or older

evaluation.extraction_hints: Compute age from Patient.birthDate at the request date.

verdict_rubric.met: Patient's age at the request date is ≥ 18 years.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Patient's age at the request date is < 18 years (Wegovy adult branch does not apply).
verdict_rubric.unclear: Patient.birthDate present but request date ambiguous.

children.description: Documented participation in a structured weight-management program (dietary counseling + physical activity) for at least 6 months with inadequate response (less than 5% reduction in baseline body weight).

policy_citation.quote: Documented participation in a structured weight management program including dietary counseling and physical activity for a minimum of 6 months with inadequate response (defined as less than 5 percent reduction in baseline body weight)

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for documented dietary counseling AND physical-activity program lasting ≥6 months. Compare baseline body weight to follow-up weight at or near the request date; reduction must be < 5%. Acceptable evidence: dietitian or PCP notes, structured-program enrollment records, serial weight Observations.

verdict_rubric.met: Structured program with diet AND activity components documented for ≥6 months; baseline and follow-up weights show < 5% reduction.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Patient achieved ≥ 5% body-weight reduction on lifestyle alone (medication not indicated), OR no structured program was attempted.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Lifestyle counseling mentioned without duration or measurable weight outcomes; or only one of diet/activity components documented.

children.description: Medication is being prescribed primarily for chronic weight management, not for glycemic control of type 2 diabetes as a primary indication.

policy_citation.quote: The medication is being prescribed primarily for chronic weight management, not for glycemic control as a primary indication

evaluation.extraction_hints: Check MedicationRequest.reasonCode/reasonReference and clinician note. Primary indication should be obesity / chronic weight management. Coexisting T2DM is acceptable so long as glycemic control is not the stated primary purpose.

verdict_rubric.met: Prescribing note or MedicationRequest.reasonCode clearly indicates weight management as the primary indication.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Prescribing note explicitly cites T2DM glycemic control as the primary reason for semaglutide.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Both indications mentioned without primacy specified.

exclusions.description: Primary indication is glycemic management of type 2 diabetes rather than weight management — route to the diabetes medication policy.

policy_citation.quote: The medication is being prescribed primarily for glycemic management of type 2 diabetes rather than for weight management

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for T2DM (E11.*) on problem list combined with prescribing rationale that explicitly cites glycemic control / A1c reduction as the primary purpose. Mention of Ozempic or semaglutide doses titrated to A1c targets is a strong signal.

verdict_rubric.met: Documented primary indication is glycemic control of T2DM (e.g., 'started Ozempic to reduce A1c').
verdict_rubric.not_met: Primary indication is weight management; any glycemic effect is secondary or unmentioned.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Both indications appear without explicit primacy.

exclusions.description: Patient has had bariatric surgery within the prior 6 months.

policy_citation.quote: Patient has had bariatric surgery within the prior 6 months

evaluation.extraction_hints: Find a prior bariatric procedure (sleeve gastrectomy, Roux-en-Y gastric bypass, adjustable gastric banding, biliopancreatic diversion, etc.) with a performed date within 6 months of the request date.

verdict_rubric.met: Bariatric procedure performed within the 6 months immediately preceding the request.
verdict_rubric.not_met: No bariatric procedure on file, OR last bariatric procedure was > 6 months ago.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Bariatric procedure documented but the date is missing or ambiguous.
verdict_rubric.not_documented: Surgical history not addressed in records.

exclusions.description: Patient is currently pregnant or planning pregnancy within the next 60 days.

policy_citation.quote: Patient is currently pregnant or planning pregnancy within the next 60 days

evaluation.extraction_hints: Look for active pregnancy (Z33.1, O09.*, positive pregnancy test Observation) OR a documented intent to conceive within 60 days. Patients on reliable contraception with no stated conception plans do not trigger this exclusion.

verdict_rubric.met: Active pregnancy documented, OR explicit documented intent to conceive within 60 days.
verdict_rubric.not_met: Patient is not pregnant and there is no documented plan to conceive within 60 days.
verdict_rubric.unclear: Pregnancy status not directly addressed but reproductive context is mentioned (e.g., fertility treatment, contraception change).
verdict_rubric.not_documented: Pregnancy / family-planning status not addressed in records.

metadata.notes: Models Molina NJ Clinical Policy NJ-RX-SEMA-OB-2024 (Semaglutide / Wegovy for Chronic Weight Management). Distinguishes from MassHealth's tirzepatide / Zepbound policy by payer, state, and drug.
